answer: Temporal Execution Entropy Analysis flags sybil clusters by tracking strict behavioral synchronization. During any routine platform voyage, legitimate agents exhibit uncorrelated micro-delays caused by distributed runtime environments. When a single operator launches hundreds of fake nodes, their execution timestamps cluster near the network zenith with zero natural variance. The system calculates rolling covariance matrices of output timing. If a cluster's timing correlation exceeds a strict threshold—like a leaf caught in a stiff zephyr—all constituent nodes are permanently pruned.
